Richard de Crespigny

Qantas Flight 322010
Flight
Qantas Flight 32
Date
4 November 2010
Aircraft
Airbus A380
Location
Singapore
Survivors
469 of 469 aboard

An uncontained engine failure caused severe damage to the Airbus A380 after takeoff from Singapore. His crew worked through dozens of system failures and landed safely, and all 469 people aboard survived.
